purpose: Ablation: does adding field-verified IHS labels improve stage 1?
wri_note: IHS objects near a WRI plant were excluded from training so the WRI independent validation stays independent.
evaluation_caveat: PR-AUC on the IHS subset is uninformative: that subset is 94.8% positive because IHS is a catalogue of confirmed sources, not a balanced sample, so a constant predictor already scores 0.948. ROC-AUC, the hard negatives and the WRI check are the meaningful reads.

matched_fp_comparison.why: B's 14.8% FP rate at threshold 0.90 is a CALIBRATION difference, not a regression. Comparing both models at the SAME false-positive rate on the 426 field-verified negatives is the like-for-like read.
matched_fp_comparison.conclusion: Essentially tied on hard-case discrimination (differences of ~2-3 points on 426 samples are noise). The real, repeatable gain is in global ranking quality, visible in the independent WRI check.

verdict.summary: Genuine improvement in ranking (WRI top-500 lift 66.1x -> 91.0x) but no gain on hard-case discrimination, and thresholds are no longer comparable to the production model. Proceed to step 2 (decade features) and re-evaluate the two changes together before promoting anything.
